title: `load` event isn't fired when iframe navigation is blocked because of CSP
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Relevant WPT test: https://wpt.fyi/results/content-security-policy/child-src/child-src-blocked.sub.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned

Currently, if the spec is implemented as-is, there is no `load` event fired when a request is blocked by CSP. In step 21.3 of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#populating-a-session-history-entry:should-navigation-request-of-type-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy we check whether the request passes CSP. If it doesn't, `response` is set to `null` and we break the iteration. Then in step 23 we return `null`, since the response error. Thus, in step 5.4 of https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry's-document we set the document to an inline document to show an error and bail out.

The `load` event for an `iframe` is fired during https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-lifecycle.html#completely-finish-loading which is only called in https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#stop-parsing Since the error document doesn't have a parser, it thus also doesn't end parsing and thus doesn't fire the `load` event.

However, the WPT tests expect the `load` event to be fired, to avoid detection if the `iframe` was blocked because of CSP. That sounds similar to #7029 In this case I still think it is detectable, given that `iframe.contentWindow` is `null` in the same-origin case.

When should we invoke the https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#iframe-load-event-steps when its blocked for CSP?
